articles.title: OKX and ICE are bringing 'never-expiring' oil futures to 120 million crypto users
articles.snippet: The new partnership comes as Hyperliquid’s oli futures contracts that never expire have been a huge success with over $1.6 billion in 24-hour trading volume.

articles.title: Mark Cuban says he sold most of his Bitcoin after failed hedge narrative 'disappointed' the billionaire
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor said he sold most of his bitcoin after concluding the cryptocurrency failed to act as a hedge during recent geopolitical turmoil and dollar weakness.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Institutions tighten their grip on Bitcoin, AI and prediction markets
articles.snippet: Institutional crypto adoption accelerates as Tether expands Bitcoin holdings, miners pivot to AI and Polymarket joins Nasdaq amid $1 billion fund outflows.

articles.title: US lawmakers renew strategic Bitcoin reserve push with ARMA bill
articles.snippet: Under the American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026, Bitcoin must be held for a minimum of 20 years unless used to slash national debt.

articles.title: GameStop Seeks to Boost Share Count as eBay Pursuit Continues After Rejection
articles.snippet: Gaming retailer GameStop wants to add 1.5 billion shares to its authorized share count as it seeks to maximize financial flexibility.
